snippet.textDisplay:
Cristiano, you didn't just play football, you made me fall in love with it. ❤️

You inspired me to start watching, loving, and dreaming about football. Watching you represent Portugal with pride and passion has been an unforgettable journey.

You may be retiring from international football, but you'll never understand how many hearts you've won along the way. You've inspired a whole generation, including me, to chase our dreams and never give up.

Thank you for every goal, every celebration, every emotion, and every memory. It hurts knowing we won't see you wear that Portugal shirt again, but your legacy will live forever.

You didn't just win trophies, Ronaldo. You won our hearts. ❤️🇵🇹

Forever my idol. Forever CR7. 🐐

snippet.textDisplay:
Dear Cristiano Ronaldo,

Thank you for everything you have given to football. You didn’t just play the game you changed it. You inspired millions of people around the world to dream bigger, work harder, and never give up.

We are all proud of you. From your incredible goals, records, trophies, and the passion you showed every time you wore the Portugal shirt, you have created a legacy that will never be forgotten.

The World Cup may not have ended the way you hoped, but one tournament does not define your greatness. You have already achieved things most players can only dream of. You showed the world what dedication, discipline, and belief look like.

Even though it hurts to lose, remember that millions of fans still stand with you. Your journey changed football forever, and your name will always be remembered among the greatest ever.

Thank you, Cristiano. You made us believe.

Edit: Thanks guys this message to ronaldo blew up in less than 12 hrs! Who loves ronaldo??
